ONE EVIDENCE SPINE · THE OPERATIONS CONSOLE

Compare the fleet. Understand the tradeoffs.

Run a robot fleet across a full shift and watch it like a real operations dashboard — fleet utilization, peak-simultaneous activity, throughput, and collision events. Origin’s deterministic oracle scores every wave, and the fleet earns a signed RSL readiness credential only if it clears the targets with zero collisions — the same evidence spine a digital agent action earns.

Every metric is computed deterministically from the oracle-verified run — no learned-coordinator result is claimed. A verdict means "reproducible under this verifier," never "safe." Seeded + replayable; synthetic layouts.

Sign this shift → fleet readiness credential

Every metric is computed deterministically from the oracle-verified run — the fleet earns an RSL readiness credential only if it clears the targets with zero collisions, and a catastrophic wave (a refused order) hard-caps the level. This is reproducible under this verifier, never "safe"; we claim no learned-coordinator result — the metrics score a verified plan, not a trained model. Synthetic layouts; seeded + replayable.
